jobs.title: Head of Customer Success
jobs.description:
About Us

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

About Energy Systems

We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.

About The Role

The Head of Customer Success
leads the customer success function within DNV Energy Systems Digital & Transformation, helping internal business customers and the clients they serve turn digital and AI-enabled capabilities into sustained, measurable value. The role sets the customer success strategy and leads a team focused on customer adoption, feature adoption, customer experience, value realization , and growth in adoption.

You will partner with business-group and service-line leaders, regional teams, Global Service Area Leads and subject matter experts (SMEs) to understand their priorities and embed useful capabilities into day-to-day work. You will also help ensure that clients understand the value of DNV's digital offerings, experience smooth adoption, and realize benefits quickly. Success means meaningful use that improves business and customer outcomes, not simply access to a platform or completion of a pilot.

Working across global teams and time zones, you will connect customer needs with product, implementation and support teams. You will establish a consistent approach to onboarding, change enablement, customer health and value measurement while allowing for differences in business-group needs and regional ways of working.

This role is based at our DNV office in Toronto, ON and Montreal, QC; offices, presenting a dynamic hybrid schedule where employees will typically spend three (3) days per week working from either a DNV office or client location/site. Further details regarding role-specific requirements will be shared during the interview process.

What You’ll Do

Customer Success Strategy & Business Partnership

Define and execute the customer success strategy across business groups, service lines and regions, aligning priorities with business outcomes, customer outcomes, and the digital product portfolio.
Build trusted relationships with senior business stakeholders and client facing teams, create joint success plans with priority use cases, adoption milestones and expected benefits.
Establish customer segmentation and engagement models that focus team capacity on the needs, readiness and value opportunities of each business group.
Lead executive business reviews, communicate progress and risks clearly, and secure business ownership of the changes needed to realize value.
Define and communicate clear value propositions that help users and clients understand the benefits of digital and AI-enabled capabilities and adopt new ways of working successfully.

Team Leadership & Customer Success Operations

Build, lead and develop the customer success team, setting clear responsibilities, coaching performance, and creating a culture of accountability and customer advocacy.
Create repeatable playbooks for onboarding, engagement, value reviews and adoption recovery.
Set team priorities and resource plans, balancing high-touch support for complex needs with scalable enablement for broader adoption.
Establish customer health reporting that combines meaningful usage, stakeholder engagement, progress toward outcomes and unresolved barriers; lead timely recovery actions.

Onboarding, Change Enablement & Sustained Adoption

Own the customer journey from readiness and onboarding through first value and sustained use, with clear responsibilities shared with business sponsors and delivery teams.
Lead role-based training, communications and change enablement that help users integrate relevant features into real business workflows.
Develop a network of business and regional champions to share practical experience, support peer learning and scale proven approaches.
Identify and address adoption barriers, including process, skills, data, product usability and policy constraints; coordinate escalation and confirm that interventions restore sustained use.

Adoption & Value Measurement

Own the four measures below. Agree eligible populations, meaningful-use criteria, starting baselines, reporting periods and targets with business stakeholders; maintain consistent definitions and review progress by business group. Measure sustained completion of relevant work, not logins alone.
Measure customer adoption as the number and share of eligible users and teams using the product meaningfully in agreed business workflows over the reporting period. Compare with the starting baseline and verify continued use across successive periods.
Measure feature adoption as the number and share of eligible users and teams applying each priority feature to relevant work during the reporting period. Compare with the feature's baseline and assess repeat use, depth of use and workflow fit, rather than one-time trials.
Measure value realized by business group as validated improvements against each group's pre-adoption baseline over an agreed period, such as time saved, reduced cycle time, improved quality or increased delivery capacity. Separate expected benefits from realized benefits and confirm sustained results with business owners.
Measure growth in adoption as the net increase in meaningfully active users and teams, and the change in adoption rates, from the baseline to subsequent comparable periods. Account for drop-off and changes in the eligible population and show whether adoption is sustained as it expands across business groups.

Customer Insight, Product Partnership & Responsible Use

Bring structured customer feedback, adoption evidence and unmet needs into product prioritization, advocating for improvements with the greatest business value.
Partner with product and delivery leaders on launch readiness, feature enablement and resolution of recurring customer issues; close the feedback loop with affected business groups.
Promote responsible digital and AI use that respects DNV's independence, confidentiality and quality requirements, with appropriate expert oversight and clear communication of capability limits.
Use validated success stories and lessons learned to scale effective practices across regions, while continuously improving the customer success operating model.

Le responsable de la réussite client
dirige la fonction succès client au sein de DNV Energy Systems Digital & Transformation, aidant les clients d'affaires internes et ceux qu'ils servent à transformer les capacités numériques et basées sur l'IA en valeur durable et mesurable. Ce rôle définit la stratégie de réussite client et dirige une équipe axée sur l'adoption client, l'adoption des fonctionnalités, l'expérience client, la réalisation de la valeur et la croissance de l'adoption.

Vous collaborerez avec des leaders de groupes d'affaires et de lignes de service, des équipes régionales, des chefs de secteur de service mondiaux et des experts en la matière (PME) pour comprendre leurs priorités et intégrer des compétences utiles dans le travail quotidien. Vous aiderez également à vous assurer que les clients comprennent la valeur des offres numériques de DNV, qu'ils vivent une adoption fluide et en tirent rapidement compte. Le succès signifie une utilisation significative qui améliore les résultats d'affaires et de clients, et non simplement l'accès à une plateforme ou la réalisation d'un projet pilote.

En travaillant à travers des équipes et des fuseaux horaires mondiaux, vous mettrez en relation les besoins des clients avec les équipes produit, d'implantation et de soutien. Vous établirez une approche cohérente pour l'intégration, l'activation du changement, la santé des clients et la mesure de la valeur tout en tenant compte des différences dans les besoins des groupes d'affaires et les modes de travail régionaux.

Ce poste est basé à notre bureau DNV à Toronto, ON et Montréal, QC; présentant un horaire hybride dynamique où les employés passent généralement trois (3) jours par semaine à travailler soit à partir d'un bureau DNV, soit d'un emplacement/site client. D'autres détails concernant les exigences spécifiques au poste seront communiqués lors du processus d'entrevue.

Ce que tu vas faire

Stratégie de réussite client et partenariat d'affaires

Définir et exécuter la stratégie de réussite client à travers les groupes d'affaires, les lignes de service et les régions, en alignant les priorités avec les résultats d'affaires, les résultats clients et le portefeuille de produits numériques.
Bâtir des relations de confiance avec les parties prenantes principales de l'entreprise et les équipes en contact avec les clients, élaborer des plans de réussite conjoints avec des cas d'utilisation prioritaires, des jalons d'adoption et des avantages attendus.
Établissez des modèles de segmentation et d'engagement de la clientèle qui concentrent la capacité de l'équipe sur les besoins, la préparation et les opportunités de valeur de chaque groupe d'affaires.
Dirigez les évaluations d'affaires par les cadres, communiquez clairement les progrès et les risques, et assurez-vous que l'entreprise prenne possession des changements nécessaires pour réaliser la valeur.
Définir et communiquer des propositions de valeur claires qui aident les utilisateurs et les clients à comprendre les avantages des capacités numériques et compatibles avec l'IA et à adopter de nouvelles façons de travailler avec succès.

Leadership d'équipe et Opérations de réussite client

Bâtir, diriger et développer l'équipe de réussite client, en définissant des responsabilités claires, en coachant la performance et en créant une culture de responsabilité et de défense des clients.
Créez des manuels de jeu répétables pour l'intégration, l'engagement, l'évaluation des valeurs et la récupération de l'adoption.
Définissez les priorités de l'équipe et les plans de ressources, en équilibrant un soutien à haute portée pour des besoins complexes avec une capacité évolutive pour une adoption plus large.
Établir des rapports sur la santé des clients qui combinent une utilisation significative, l'engagement des parties prenantes, les progrès vers les résultats et les obstacles non résolus; diriger des actions de rétablissement en temps opportun.

Intégration, habilitation au changement et adoption durable

Assumez le parcours client depuis la préparation et l'intégration, jusqu'à la première valeur et l'utilisation soutenue, avec des responsabilités claires partagées avec les commanditaires d'affaires et les équipes de livraison.
Dirigez la formation basée sur les rôles, la communication et l'activation du changement qui aident les utilisateurs à intégrer les fonctionnalités pertinentes dans les flux de travail réels d'affaires.
Développez un réseau de champions des entreprises et régionaux pour partager leur expérience pratique, soutenir l'apprentissage par les pairs et faire évoluer des approches éprouvées.
Identifier et aborder les obstacles à l'adoption, y compris les procédés, les compétences, les données, l'utilisabilité du produit et les contraintes politiques; coordonner l'escalade et confirmer que les interventions restaurent une utilisation durable.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Process Excellence
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

A lot of companies are still working out what AI means for how work gets done. At Equinix, this role sits at the center of that question. In this role, you’ll help decide how the company reimagines its most critical value streams leveraging AI, and how its leaders build the management habits that make the changes stick.

The Senior Director, Process Excellence guides how Equinix reimagines some of its most critical value streams for AI transformation. Forward-deployed engineers build and deploy the solutions. This leader facilitates the work that comes before and alongside them: bringing business leaders and engineers into the same room to examine how work flows today, decide what the future flow should look like, and place AI and human judgment where each adds the most value, so the redesign starts from outcomes and decisions rather than from tools.

The role also develops the management practices / operating system that put continuous improvement principles to work, drawing on lean principles, along with the toolset that supports them, in partnership with HR. In selected areas of focus, this leader coaches parts of the organization directly on building the operating system that sustains a culture of continuous improvement. You’ll work with business leaders, people team, and our Digital and Innovation Organization, with visibility to senior leadership.

Responsibilities

Reimagining Critical Value Streams for AI Transformation

Facilitate working sessions with business leaders and forward-deployed engineers to examine how work actually flows, find the structural bottlenecks, handoffs, and rework, and define the future flow before solutions are built
Bring Lean, Six Sigma, BPM, and value stream thinking together with process and process mining, so the redesign is grounded in how work runs today and aimed at measurable gains in speed, quality, cost, and decision-making
Help business leaders design for decisions and outcomes rather than tasks, build intelligence into core workflows, and place AI, automation, and human judgment where each adds the most value
Advise senior leaders on where AI applies and where it does not, and challenge designs that only speed up an existing process
Connect business leaders, the Digital and AI organization, and change efforts so that opportunities move from identification to deployment and adoption
Promote always-on visibility into how redesigned processes perform, so gains are sustained and drift is caught early
Establish a consistent approach across the enterprise to prioritizing, framing, and launching value stream redesigns

Management Practices / Operating System

Develop the Equinix management practices / operating system that builds from some of the best and enforces continuous improvement principles into daily use, including visual management, structured problem solving, performance management, and standard work
Build, with partners, the toolset that supports those practices, including standards, templates, and routines that teams can adopt and adapt
Work with HR so the practices reinforce the leadership expectations set for the company, and so the language, learning experiences, and capability pathways are consistent
Help create the shared language and mindset that make continuous improvement part of how the company operates
Coach selected parts of the organization on best practices for building the operating system that drives continuous improvement, with hands-on enablement in priority areas so teams and leaders can apply the practices and the redesign approach themselves
Decide what is standard across the enterprise and what can flex by region or function, and set a deliberate path for starting the practices where they will take hold
Embed process excellence disciplines at scale, and build communities of practice in process redesign and AI-enabled improvement so the capability spreads beyond this team
Assess how mature the practices are across the organization, establish feedback loops on adoption and effectiveness, and refine the system based on what is learned

Qualifications

Required

12–15+ years leading enterprise-level operational excellence, process excellence, or large-scale change in complex, global organizations
Fluency in Lean, Six Sigma, BPM, and value stream methods, and the ability to apply them to redesign how end-to-end work flows
Working knowledge of AI, analytics, automation, and digital platforms, with the ability to translate capability into business outcomes
Strong facilitation and coaching skills, with credibility working with senior leaders and executives
Experience developing management practices and tools built on lean principles, and helping an organization adopt them at scale
Deep understanding of organizational behavior and what it takes to change habits and shared language
Comfort building something without an established playbook, balancing structure with pragmatism
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or equivalent experience

Preferred

Hands-on experience with process or task mining
Experience partnering with HR on capability programs
Experience in technology, services, or infrastructure environments
Lean Six Sigma, change management, or comparable certification

jobs.description:
LinkedIn is the world's largest professional network, built to create economic opportunity for every member of the global workforce. Our products help people make powerful connections, discover exciting opportunities, build necessary skills, and gain valuable insights every day. We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.

Join us to transform the way the world works.

Job Description

At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.

We are looking for a Large Enterprise Account Director to join our team as a trusted adviser with a relentless focus on bringing value to our customers within the Enterprise sector. You will be responsible for helping our customers effectively engage with our solutions (Talent & Learning). You will be dedicated to making our customers stronger and seeking out opportunities for growth. Although you possess a strategic approach to selling and strive to meet/exceed revenue goals, you will always have your clients’ best interest in mind and act as their internal advocate to ensure they are set up for success. 

Responsibilities: 

Researches Customer’s business and prepares thoughtful questions and insights in advance of customer meetings 

Asks layered, open-ended questions to understand and clarify Customer’s objectives and challenges beyond surface-level detail 

Builds relationships with multiple stakeholders (vertically and horizontally) across the Customer’s organization 

Shifts communication style and content to fit the needs of different stakeholders 

Leads with Solutions, not products, when making recommendations aligned to Customer objectives 

Sells with Integrity 

Drives customer decision making by achieving shared vision and proactively considering the value props that tie all stakeholders together 

Thinks commercially and applies business acumen when crafting & negotiating commercial agreements  

Uses data and insights to support investment recommendations or overcome customer objections  

Proactively mitigates churn risk by adopting a smart, customer-centric approach 

Engages customers throughout to confirm and clarify value and adapts a strategy when needed to optimize ROI 

Drives Customer growth by proactively identifying opportunities to deliver greater customer value 

Applies business acumen in Account Planning by considering economic, industry, and company factors with a Customer-centric lens.  

Maps all key stakeholders in an account to assess the strength of the account relationship and create account outreach strategy 

Agrees to joint accountability with colleagues and cross-functional teams for optimal customer success 

Practices humility and asks for help from colleagues when faced with a challenge or unknown 

Is disciplined in Territory and Account Planning, Forecasting, and Quota Attainment 

Follows best practices when using CRM and other Sales tools in order to manage the Sales and Buyer cycles

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications: 

8+ years of applicable sales experience 

Preferred Qualifications: 

Experience with HR software 

BA/BS degree or equivalent in a related field 

Experience with SaaS opportunities and Salesforce.com platform 

Experience selling IT solutions 

Knowledge of software contract terms and conditions with the ability to create fair transactions 

Strong negotiation and accurate forecasting skills 

Experience carrying a revenue target with the ability to develop compelling strategies that deliver results 

Excellent communication, negotiation and forecasting skills 

Demonstrated ability to find and manage high-level business in an evangelistic sales environment 

Ability to gather and use data to inform decision making and persuade others 

Ability to assess business opportunities and read prospective buyers 

Ability to orchestrate the closure of business with an accurate understanding of prospect needs 

Ability to include multiple partners and members of the company management team using competitive selling to position company products against direct and indirect competitors

Negotiation

Communication

Persuasion

jobs.description:
At AstraZeneca, we pride ourselves on crafting a collaborative culture that champions knowledge-sharing, ambitious thinking and innovation – ultimately providing employees with the opportunity to work across teams, functions and even the globe.

Recognizing the importance of individualized flexibility, our ways of working allow employees to balance personal and work commitments while ensuring we continue to create a strong culture of collaboration and teamwork by engaging face-to-face in our offices 3 days a week. Our head office and BlueSky Hub in downtown Toronto are purposely designed with collaboration in mind, providing space where teams can come together to strategize, brainstorm and connect on key projects.

Our dedication to sustainability is also central to our culture and part of what makes AstraZeneca a great place to work. We know the health of people, the planet and our business are interconnected which is why we’re taking ambitious action to tackle some of the biggest challenges of our time, from climate change to access to healthcare and disease prevention

As a key strategic leadership position within AstraZeneca Canada, this position mentors and manages a team of professionals responsible for developing and implementing pricing strategies for AstraZeneca’s portfolio (OBU, BBU), driving pricing innovation and pricing governance and early aaset input. The individual

Responsibilities

Lead, develop and cultivate the Strategic Pricing team, empowering a team culture aligned to AstraZeneca’s values, fostering an environment of innovation, a solutions-oriented approach to problem solving and a strong focus to achieve results
Establish forward-thinking pricing strategies including list and net price approaches for all AZ brands: Leads the development and local/global approval of gross and net pricing strategies
Develop viable deal structures for payer negotiations and build innovative, fit-for-purpose contracting solutions for public and private payers that improve near and long term brand contribution
Lead early asset input, shaping pricing and commercial potential
Responsible for adherence to global pricing policies and managing processes for exceptions management
Implement processes for the planning and analyses of rebates and chargebacks for all pricing contracts (public, private, hospital/GPO)
Collaborate with business units to create and communicate the pricing requirements for each business segment, develop the financial models, consolidate data to allow for multiple views of the information, and prepare presentations for leadership review
Work with Commercial Financial Planning to understand the financial impact of current gross-to-net reserves, pipeline stocking, existing and future contracting on Net Sales results
Responsible for pricing compliance and reporting requirements locally and globally including PMPRB reporting, monitoring, and issues management.
Advise and leads AZ position and response to policy changes that involve pricing aligned to our corporate strategic direction (i.e. PMPRB)
Advise business on net price impact and performance for Patient Support Program offerings including Free Drug Programs and co-pay support – responsible for local and global pricing approvals process related to the above
Establish & monitor pricing metrics including year-over-year price variance by brand and by region, assess net price performance vs. targeted goals
Remain current on pricing environment and engages with industry associations and key industry colleagues to proactively identify emerging trends, opportunities or challenges in the market place including government health policy changes and cost containment initiatives.

Qualifications

Bachelors’ degree in a relevant quantitative specialty. MBA is an asset.
Significant relevant pharmaceutical experience (7-10+ years) in Market Access, including specific dedicated experience in Market Access Strategy or Pricing
Solid understanding and experience with Canadian payer environment and PMPRB specifically
Experienced team and people leader with previous people management experience
Ability to think strategically about complex and systematic challenges, and able to build results oriented approaches
Track record of leveraging analytic rigour to deliver business-optimized solutions
Business knowledge and credibility at senior commercial levels
Strong interpersonal and influencing abilities
Excellent communications skills (written, spoken and presentation)
Strong people leadership skills, passionate about developing teams
Strong negotiation and facilitation skills; strong communication skills
Strategically agile with strong business insight and can synthesize information from diverse sources to build strategies and solutions

Identify and address adoption barriers, including process, skills, data, product usability and policy constraints; coordinate escalation and confirm that interventions restore sustained use.

Adoption & Value Measurement

Own the four measures below. Agree eligible populations, meaningful-use criteria, starting baselines, reporting periods and targets with business stakeholders; maintain consistent definitions and review progress by business group. Measure sustained completion of relevant work, not logins alone.
Measure customer adoption as the number and share of eligible users and teams using the product meaningfully in agreed business workflows over the reporting period. Compare with the starting baseline and verify continued use across successive periods.
Measure feature adoption as the number and share of eligible users and teams applying each priority feature to relevant work during the reporting period. Compare with the feature's baseline and assess repeat use, depth of use and workflow fit, rather than one-time trials.
Measure value realized by business group as validated improvements against each group's pre-adoption baseline over an agreed period, such as time saved, reduced cycle time, improved quality or increased delivery capacity. Separate expected benefits from realized benefits and confirm sustained results with business owners.
Measure growth in adoption as the net increase in meaningfully active users and teams, and the change in adoption rates, from the baseline to subsequent comparable periods. Account for drop-off and changes in the eligible population and show whether adoption is sustained as it expands across business groups.

Customer Insight, Product Partnership & Responsible Use

Bring structured customer feedback, adoption evidence and unmet needs into product prioritization, advocating for improvements with the greatest business value.
Partner with product and delivery leaders on launch readiness, feature enablement and resolution of recurring customer issues; close the feedback loop with affected business groups.
Promote responsible digital and AI use that respects DNV's independence, confidentiality and quality requirements, with appropriate expert oversight and clear communication of capability limits.
Use validated success stories and lessons learned to scale effective practices across regions, while continuously improving the customer success operating model.

Le responsable de la réussite client
dirige la fonction succès client au sein de DNV Energy Systems Digital & Transformation, aidant les clients d'affaires internes et ceux qu'ils servent à transformer les capacités numériques et basées sur l'IA en valeur durable et mesurable. Vous collaborerez avec des leaders de groupes d'affaires et de lignes de service, des équipes régionales, des chefs de secteur de service mondiaux et des experts en la matière (PME) pour comprendre leurs priorités et intégrer des compétences utiles dans le travail quotidien. Le succès signifie une utilisation significative qui améliore les résultats d'affaires et de clients, et non simplement l'accès à une plateforme ou la réalisation d'un projet pilote.

En travaillant à travers des équipes et des fuseaux horaires mondiaux, vous mettrez en relation les besoins des clients avec les équipes produit, d'implantation et de soutien. Bâtir des relations de confiance avec les parties prenantes principales de l'entreprise et les équipes en contact avec les clients, élaborer des plans de réussite conjoints avec des cas d'utilisation prioritaires, des jalons d'adoption et des avantages attendus.
Établissez des modèles de segmentation et d'engagement de la clientèle qui concentrent la capacité de l'équipe sur les besoins, la préparation et les opportunités de valeur de chaque groupe d'affaires.
Dirigez les évaluations d'affaires par les cadres, communiquez clairement les progrès et les risques, et assurez-vous que l'entreprise prenne possession des changements nécessaires pour réaliser la valeur.
Définir et communiquer des propositions de valeur claires qui aident les utilisateurs et les clients à comprendre les avantages des capacités numériques et compatibles avec l'IA et à adopter de nouvelles façons de travailler avec succès.

Leadership d'équipe et Opérations de réussite client

Bâtir, diriger et développer l'équipe de réussite client, en définissant des responsabilités claires, en coachant la performance et en créant une culture de responsabilité et de défense des clients.

new_jobs.title: Senior Director, Process Excellence
new_jobs.description:
Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.

A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Job Summary

A lot of companies are still working out what AI means for how work gets done. At Equinix, this role sits at the center of that question. In this role, you’ll help decide how the company reimagines its most critical value streams leveraging AI, and how its leaders build the management habits that make the changes stick.

The Senior Director, Process Excellence guides how Equinix reimagines some of its most critical value streams for AI transformation. Forward-deployed engineers build and deploy the solutions. This leader facilitates the work that comes before and alongside them: bringing business leaders and engineers into the same room to examine how work flows today, decide what the future flow should look like, and place AI and human judgment where each adds the most value, so the redesign starts from outcomes and decisions rather than from tools.

The role also develops the management practices / operating system that put continuous improvement principles to work, drawing on lean principles, along with the toolset that supports them, in partnership with HR. In selected areas of focus, this leader coaches parts of the organization directly on building the operating system that sustains a culture of continuous improvement. You’ll work with business leaders, people team, and our Digital and Innovation Organization, with visibility to senior leadership.

Responsibilities

Reimagining Critical Value Streams for AI Transformation

Facilitate working sessions with business leaders and forward-deployed engineers to examine how work actually flows, find the structural bottlenecks, handoffs, and rework, and define the future flow before solutions are built
Bring Lean, Six Sigma, BPM, and value stream thinking together with process and process mining, so the redesign is grounded in how work runs today and aimed at measurable gains in speed, quality, cost, and decision-making
Help business leaders design for decisions and outcomes rather than tasks, build intelligence into core workflows, and place AI, automation, and human judgment where each adds the most value
Advise senior leaders on where AI applies and where it does not, and challenge designs that only speed up an existing process
Connect business leaders, the Digital and AI organization, and change efforts so that opportunities move from identification to deployment and adoption
Promote always-on visibility into how redesigned processes perform, so gains are sustained and drift is caught early
Establish a consistent approach across the enterprise to prioritizing, framing, and launching value stream redesigns

Management Practices / Operating System

Develop the Equinix management practices / operating system that builds from some of the best and enforces continuous improvement principles into daily use, including visual management, structured problem solving, performance management, and standard work
Build, with partners, the toolset that supports those practices, including standards, templates, and routines that teams can adopt and adapt
Work with HR so the practices reinforce the leadership expectations set for the company, and so the language, learning experiences, and capability pathways are consistent
Help create the shared language and mindset that make continuous improvement part of how the company operates
Coach selected parts of the organization on best practices for building the operating system that drives continuous improvement, with hands-on enablement in priority areas so teams and leaders can apply the practices and the redesign approach themselves
Decide what is standard across the enterprise and what can flex by region or function, and set a deliberate path for starting the practices where they will take hold
Embed process excellence disciplines at scale, and build communities of practice in process redesign and AI-enabled improvement so the capability spreads beyond this team
Assess how mature the practices are across the organization, establish feedback loops on adoption and effectiveness, and refine the system based on what is learned

Qualifications

Required

12–15+ years leading enterprise-level operational excellence, process excellence, or large-scale change in complex, global organizations
Fluency in Lean, Six Sigma, BPM, and value stream methods, and the ability to apply them to redesign how end-to-end work flows
Working knowledge of AI, analytics, automation, and digital platforms, with the ability to translate capability into business outcomes
Strong facilitation and coaching skills, with credibility working with senior leaders and executives
Experience developing management practices and tools built on lean principles, and helping an organization adopt them at scale
Deep understanding of organizational behavior and what it takes to change habits and shared language
Comfort building something without an established playbook, balancing structure with pragmatism
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or equivalent experience

Preferred

Hands-on experience with process or task mining
Experience partnering with HR on capability programs
Experience in technology, services, or infrastructure environments
Lean Six Sigma, change management, or comparable certification

The individual

Responsibilities

Lead, develop and cultivate the Strategic Pricing team, empowering a team culture aligned to AstraZeneca’s values, fostering an environment of innovation, a solutions-oriented approach to problem solving and a strong focus to achieve results
Establish forward-thinking pricing strategies including list and net price approaches for all AZ brands: Leads the development and local/global approval of gross and net pricing strategies
Develop viable deal structures for payer negotiations and build innovative, fit-for-purpose contracting solutions for public and private payers that improve near and long term brand contribution
Lead early asset input, shaping pricing and commercial potential
Responsible for adherence to global pricing policies and managing processes for exceptions management
Implement processes for the planning and analyses of rebates and chargebacks for all pricing contracts (public, private, hospital/GPO)
